site-width" id="below-slider-wrapper"><div class="region region-belowslider"><div class="block block-block first last odd" id="block-block-2"><h1 class="rtecenter">Online whisky auction: Buy and sell iconic, rare and collectible whisky.</h1><p class="rtecenter"><strong><em><span style="color:#4d4d4d">Whisky Auctioneer hosts monthly online whisky auctions which provide an easy and accessible platform to find an unrivalled selection of rare Scotch whisky, Japanese Whisky, Irish Whiskey, Bourbon and other World Whiskies. Our live whisky auctions also feature other spirits such as Cognac, Armagnac, Tequila, <a href="http://www.rumauctioneer.com">Rum</a>, Vodka, Gin and <a href="http://www.wineauctioneer.com" target="_blank">Wine</a>.  </span></em></strong></p><p class="rtecenter"><strong>If you are interested in selling online, we provide a completely hassle-free service with free expert valuations, complimentary bottle collections across the UK and the market authority to reach a global audience of interested buyers. We'd love to help buy or sell rare whisky and spirits, so for more information please <span style="color:#4d4d4d"><a href="/contact-us">contact us</a></span>. </strong></p><p class="rtecenter"><strong> </strong></p></div></div></div><div class="clearfix" id="middle-wrapper"><div class="clearfix site-width" id="middle"><div class="clearfix" id="homepage-product-listing"><div class="region region-below-content"><div class="block block-block first last odd" id="block-block-21"><h2 class="block__title block-title">The Largest Private Collection of Whisky is Going To Auction</h2><div class="clearfix"><div class="right-col"><a href="https://whiskylink.co/teaser"><img alt="committee" src="/sites/default/files/images/pc-webblock.jpg" style="float:right; height:632px; width:1200px"/></a></div><p> </p><p>Whisky Auctioneer will soon be announcing the details on the largest private collection of whisky to ever go to auction on the secondary market.</p><p>The unprecedented collection of well over 3,500 rare and remarkable whiskies provides a historic and all-encompassing snapshot of the whisky industry - including the largest private collection of <strong>The Macallan, Bowmore and Springbank, plus numerous closed and lost distilleries of Scotland</strong>.</p><p>To be one of the first to find out details and information on the Collection, <a href="http://whiskylink.co/teaser">please register your interest here</a>. </p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="clearfix" id="auctionmessages"><div class="region region-auctionmessage"><div class="block block-block first last odd" id="block-block-25"> <strong>October 2019 Auction </strong> ends <strong></strong> Monday 4th November <i>from</i> 7pm GMT.
